name: Potchefstroom
story: Potchefstroom brings Lerato into a university town where living collections offer a different way to learn about the landscape.
history: The North-West University botanical garden grew from the university’s botanical work and sits alongside its Potchefstroom campus.

experience.activity: Visit the NWU Botanical Garden and explore its plants and garden displays.
